Film workers' body criticizes Tanushree Dutta over remarks on Nana Patekar

The All India Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has criticized actress Tanushree Dutta for her remarks about actor Nana Patekar, which were described as an 'evil dead' comment. AICWA stated, 'Humanity Seems Dead' and advised Dutta to 'keep a check on your tongue.' The association's criticism followed Dutta's comments regarding Nana Patekar.
